cmd:
wget -q -O /root/my-bot/marketolog_bot.py 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WellnessCode/Soloviova/main/marketolog_bot.py' && cat > /etc/systemd/system/marketolog.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Marketolog Instagram Bot
After=network.target

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=/root/my-bot
ExecStart=/root/my-bot/venv/bin/python /root/my-bot/marketolog_bot.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable marketolog && systemctl start marketolog && systemctl status marketolog --no-pager
